links.outcome: Model AUC on external Oxford cohort versus Southampton training cohort with differing baseline characteristics
links.effect: External AUCs for the primary treatment model stayed high (MLR 0.894, XGB 0.887, RF 0.891). The palliative classifier fell to MLR 0.711, XGB 0.742, RF 0.730, versus internal 0.793-0.815 (k=5 cross-validation).
links.quote: On external validation (OUH cohort), AUCs were MLR 0.894, XGB 0.887 and RF 0.891 for the primary treatment model and MLR 0.711, XGB 0.742 and RF 0.730 for the palliative treatment classifier.

unlisted_practices: Responsible Research and Innovation co-design of a clinical decision support interface with clinicians, programmers and patient representatives
Integrated user education and prediction explanations within the decision support tool

screen.reason: The study develops and externally validates a clinical decision support model while conducting an empirical stakeholder co-design process (RRI framework with clinicians and patient advocates) to evaluate and implement user interface modifications, explainability aids, and integrated education.

primary.practice: stakeholder co-design via Responsible Research and Innovation (RRI)
